title: GLua formatter configuration
description: Formatting rules for the GLua language server. Overrides .editorconfig, .prettierrc and your editor settings.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema for this file.

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

indentSize.description: Spaces per indent level, and the assumed display width of a tab.

maxLineWidth.description: Column at which tables and argument lists wrap.

quoteStyle.description: Preferred string quotes. A string is only rewritten when doing so needs no extra escaping.

operatorStyle.description: 'lua' rewrites GLua's C-style operators != && || ! as ~= and or not.

spaceInsideParens.description: Write func( a, b ) instead of func(a, b). This is the style used across the Garry's Mod wiki.

keepSingleLineBlocks.description: Keep blocks written on one line on one line, e.g. 'if not IsValid(ent) then return end'.

maxBlankLines.description: Consecutive blank lines to keep between statements.

semicolons.description: Whether to keep optional trailing semicolons.

endOfLine.description: Line ending to write. Defaults to whatever the file already uses.

overrides.description: Per-path formatting overrides, applied in order; later entries win.

files.description: Glob patterns relative to this file's directory, e.g. lua/vendor/**.

options.description: Formatting options to apply to matching files.
